notes.title: 🎉 Super Stream-Bara: Demo Update – Next Fest Developer Showcase! 🎉
notes.notes:
[h3]This time, things are getting [i]extra crunchy[/i] with a brand-new demo update debuting just in time for Steam Next Fest.[/h3][h1]
[b]What’s New in the Demo?[/b][/h1][list][*][p][i]Story and NPCs have been reworked. Be sure to check out every secret![/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Emotes! Player can now send emotes to each other![/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Private rooms. You can now create and join private games. Perfect for a playthrough with friends or... a stream with your favourite creator![/i][/p][/*][*][p]Voting effects rebalanced. Those should be more impactful now.[/p][/*][*][p]Bunch of small fixes and improvements.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Don’t miss your chance to dive snout-first into the weirdest streamer adventure of the year.[/h3]

notes.title: Super Stream-Bara Demo Update - version 0.04
notes.notes:
[h2]Version 0.04 Changelog:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Demo split into two parts: Chapter 1 & Nightmare (Nightmare offers harder levels),
[*] Story rework (new npc - evil ghost!),
[*] New feature: Emotes! Players can now send each other emojis,
[*] Voting effects balanced so they appear less, but are more impactful,
[*] New voting animation that show exactly who's voting on what effect,
[*] Private rooms,
[*] Game UI reworked,
[*] Various bugfixes and improvements
[/list]
